purpose: Provide a disposable session-state project for Codex Plugin host-routing evaluation.

capabilities.name: Session refresh
capabilities.description: Keep the newest authenticated session when refresh results arrive out of order.

invariants.name: Session generation is monotonic
invariants.statement: A refresh with an older generation never replaces a newer authenticated session.

components.name: Session core
components.responsibility: Implement and verify local session refresh ordering.

decisions.title: Use a dependency-free local Python Gate
decisions.rationale: The disposable fixture must not install dependencies or use the network.

contracts.description: Stable ordering and validation rules for session refresh.
